name: patient_has_diagnosis_of_parkinson_s_disease_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient currently has a diagnosis of idiopathic Parkinson's disease.
when_true: Set to true if the patient currently has a diagnosis of idiopathic Parkinson's disease.
when_false: Set to false if the patient currently does not have a diagnosis of idiopathic Parkinson's disease.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient currently has a diagnosis of idiopathic Parkinson's disease.

name: patient_has_finding_of_abnormal_gait_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient currently has abnormal gait.
when_true: Set to true if the patient currently has the clinical finding of abnormal gait.
when_false: Set to false if the patient currently does not have the clinical finding of abnormal gait.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient currently has the clinical finding of abnormal gait.

name: patient_has_finding_of_abnormal_gait_now@@is_main_complaint_or_main_symptom
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient's abnormal gait is the main complaint or main symptom.
when_true: Set to true if the patient's abnormal gait is the main complaint or main symptom.
when_false: Set to false if the patient's abnormal gait is not the main complaint or main symptom.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient's abnormal gait is the main complaint or main symptom.

name: patient_hoehn_and_yahr_scale_score_value_recorded_now_withunit_none
meaning: Numeric value representing the patient's Hoehn and Yahr scale score as recorded now (unitless).
when_unknown: Set to null if no such measurement is available or the value is indeterminate.
when_value: Set to the measured Hoehn and Yahr scale score if a numeric measurement recorded now is available.

name: patient_has_diagnosis_of_dementia_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient currently has a diagnosis of dementia.
when_true: Set to true if the patient currently has a diagnosis of dementia.
when_false: Set to false if the patient currently does not have a diagnosis of dementia.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient currently has a diagnosis of dementia.

name: patient_hoehn_and_yahr_scale_score_value_recorded_now_withunit_score
meaning: Numeric value representing the patient's Hoehn and Yahr scale score as measured now.
when_unknown: Set to null if no such measurement is available or the value is indeterminate.
when_value: Set to the measured Hoehn and Yahr scale score if a numeric measurement is recorded now.

name: patient_duration_of_parkinsons_disease_symptoms_value_recorded_now_in_years
meaning: Numeric value indicating the duration, in years, that the patient has had symptoms of Parkinson's disease up to the present time.
when_unknown: Set to null if the duration of Parkinson's disease symptoms in years is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined.
when_value: Set to the number of years since the patient first developed symptoms of Parkinson's disease, as documented or reported, up to the present time.

name: patient_has_finding_of_parkinsonian_features_now
meaning: auto-synthesized variable for parkinsonian_features (Clinical finding) with timeframe now
when_true: Set to true if the patient currently exhibits clinical features consistent with parkinsonian symptoms.
when_false: Set to false if the patient does not currently exhibit clinical features consistent with parkinsonian symptoms.
when_unknown: Set to null if the presence or absence of parkinsonian features is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined.
